name: Comcast Corporation
description: Comcast is currently organized around Connectivity & Platforms (Xfinity residential broadband, video and wireless via the Xfinity Mobile MVNO riding Verizon's network, plus Comcast Business services to enterprises) and Content & Experiences (NBCUniversal's broadcast/cable networks, Universal Pictures film studio, Peacock streaming service, Universal theme parks, and Sky, its European pay-TV/broadband operator). Comcast completed the spin-off of Versant Media Group (a subset of its cable television networks) in January 2026, and on 2026-06-29 announced its intention to separate NBCUniversal and Sky together into a standalone, independently-traded company via a tax-free transaction targeted to close in approximately 12 months, which — if completed as announced — would leave a much more narrowly-defined broadband/connectivity company at Comcast (CMCSA) itself.
